answer_2.quote: We quantify the quality of our constructed vulnerable examples through two metrics: (1) GPT-2 perplexity quantifies the naturalness of a sentence (smaller is better). ... (2) ℓ0 norm distance quantifies the disparity between two sentences (smaller is better).

answer_4.quote: We perform human evaluation on the examples constructed by SO-Beam. Specifically, we randomly select 100 successful attacks and evaluate both the original examples and the vulnerable examples. To evaluate the naturalness of the constructed examples, we ask the annotators to score the likelihood (on a Likert scale of 1-5, 5 to be the most likely) of being an original example based on the grammar correctness. To evaluate the semantic similarity after applying the synonym substitution p, we ask the annotators to predict the sentiment of each example, and calculate the ratio of examples that maintain the same sentiment prediction after the synonym substitution.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators rate naturalness on a 1-5 Likert scale and predict sentiment to assess semantic consistency.
